# AI Disclosure

English | [简体中文](DISCLOSURE.md)

**All code and documentation** in this repository (Mycelium) were generated by AI models.
No part was written line by line by a human, and none of it has undergone full human
review or evaluation. This includes, but is not limited to:

- Source code: `crates/` (8 crates, including their `examples/`);
- Documentation: `README.md`, `README.en.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, per-crate `README.md` files,
  `docs/` (contracts under `docs/spec/`, architecture and release process under `docs/architecture/`,
  raw integration logs under `docs/integration/`);
- Build and configuration files: `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `.github/workflows/`,
  `rust-toolchain.toml`, `rustfmt.toml`, `deny.toml`, `mutants.toml`, `LICENSE-MIT`,
  `LICENSE-APACHE`, and so on.

> [!NOTE]
> The integration logs under `docs/integration/` are verbatim records of real interactions with
> DeepSeek produced by AI-written example programs. The interactions are real, but the assertions,
> conclusions and explanatory text were written by AI; their reliability is not guaranteed.

This disclosure file itself was also generated by AI.

AI model involved:

- **deepseek-v4.1-flash**

AI-generated content may contain errors or outdated information; review and evaluate it
yourself before adopting, citing or redistributing it.
